FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToF.en:
That MEADOW has belonged to our
family for generations.\pI should have had a giant mansion
built on it.\pIt would be preferable to having
those thugs run wild on it!
FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToF.fr:
Cette PRAIRIE appartient à notre
famille depuis des générations.\pJ'aurais dû y faire construire un
immense manoir.\pCe serait mieux que d'y laisser
courir ces voyous !
